tasks.message: Design a batch workflow to backfill 12 million property records from S3 parquet into Persist through its ingest API, which tolerates about 200 requests/second. I need the execution shape, cost gate, throttling, idempotency and recovery strategy and a small end-to-end verification path. Architecture only.

must_include: a chosen execution shape (Step Functions Distributed Map, Glue or hybrid) with the reason
an explicit external dependency boundary assessment for the Persist ingest API
a cost gate before full volume
a small-scale verification step before full volume
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value

tasks.message: Assess this existing design: a single Lambda loops over every account in a DynamoDB scan, calls the LiveVox API for each without a queue, and retries forever on 429. List only concrete violations of the batch-workflow principles and what to change.

must_include: unbounded retries on 429 named as a violation
missing queued boundary or concurrency limit for the external API
Lambda timeout and resumability risk for a full scan
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value
rewrites the system without naming the violated principle
